# Command Code Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Command Code configuration. The main output is `.commandcode/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - command-code
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - command-code:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property          | Value                                       |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                                      |
| **Main output**   | `.commandcode/rules/project.md`             |
| **Dot directory** | `.commandcode/`                             |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.commandcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | No                                          |
| **Commands**      | Yes (`.commandcode/commands/<name>.md`)     |
| **Local files**   | No                                          |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                                  | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.commandcode/rules/project.md`       | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.commandcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |
| Commands          | `.commandcode/commands/<name>.md`     | Slash commands             |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                                                                |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .commandcode/rules/project.md file                                                             |
| `multifile`      | .commandcode/rules/project.md + .commandcode/commands/<name>.md (skills via full mode)                |
| `full` (default) | .commandcode/rules/project.md + .commandcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md + .commandcode/commands/<name>.md |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
